title: Improving storage efficiency in Magic Pocket, our immutable blob store
summary: Reclaims sparse volumes that host-and-donor compaction drained too slowly via DP packing and Live Coder re-encoding.

title: What’s new with Robinhood, our in-house load balancing service
summary: Stops uneven load that forced over-provisioning with Robinhood, whose per-node PID controllers set endpoint weights.

title: Meet Chrono, our scalable, consistent, metadata caching solution
summary: Offloads reads Panda could not sustain to Memcache, keeping read-after-write by checking Chrono's write-attempt times.

title: Increasing Magic Pocket write throughput by removing our SSD cache disks
summary: Lifts the write throughput cap of a per-host SSD cache by writing straight to SMR disks with inline block metadata.

title: Future-proofing our metadata stack with Panda, a scalable key-value store
summary: Avoids costly fleet-wide MySQL splits with Panda, a transactional KV layer that grows capacity by range transfer.

title: Everything in its write place: Cloud storage abstraction with Object Store
summary: Cuts S3 per-request bills from small PUTs by batching them into shared blobs indexed by offsets in MySQL.

title: That time we unplugged a data center to test our disaster readiness
summary: Replaces an outage-causing failover script with a runbook DAG, then unplugs San Jose to prove nothing depends on it.

title: Atlas: Our journey from a Python monolith to a managed platform
summary: Splits Metaserver, where any critical bug forced a full rollback, into Atlasservlet clusters the Atlas team runs.

title: Alki, or how we learned to stop worrying and love cold metadata
summary: Eases Edgestore's capacity crunch by moving cold audit logs into Alki, an LSM tree with DynamoDB and S3 tiers.

title: How we designed Dropbox ATF: an async task framework
summary: Recovers ATF tasks dropped by RPC or SQS failures with per-state deadlines after which a poller re-enqueues them.

title: Broccoli: Syncing faster by syncing less
summary: Trims sync bytes zlib left on the wire with Broccoli, a Rust Brotli whose chunks concatenate for multicore encoding.

title: How we migrated Dropbox from Nginx to Envoy
summary: Moves the edge off Nginx, weak on gRPC and fed by tangled templated configs, to Envoy with protobuf-typed config.

title: Testing sync at Dropbox
summary: Fixes flaky, unreproducible randomized tests by making Nucleus deterministic per seed for CanopyCheck and Trinity.

title: Rewriting the heart of our sync engine
summary: Escapes a data model with no stable file IDs, which refactoring could not fix, by rewriting sync as Nucleus in Rust.

title: Enhancing Bandaid load balancing at Dropbox by leveraging real-time backend server load information
summary: Evens out backend load that Bandaid's local request counts misjudged by piggybacking server utilization on responses.

title: How we optimized Magic Pocket for cold storage
summary: Drops the full per-region copy of cold data by striping block fragments and an XOR parity across independent regions.

title: Courier: Dropbox migration to gRPC
summary: Curbs cascading overload, once left to custom client backoff, with Courier's mandatory deadlines and LIFO queue.

title: Cape Technical Deep Dive
summary: Rejects queues, where a failing subject blocks others, for a dispatcher that schedules from source pings and cursors.

title: Cross shard transactions at 10 million requests per second
summary: Ends app-level workarounds for cross-shard writes in Edgestore with two-phase commit on an external transaction record.

title: Dropbox traffic infrastructure: Edge network
summary: Tackles PoP misrouting by anycast hop counts and GeoIP guesses with a prototype DNS map from client-measured latency.

title: Extending Magic Pocket Innovation with the first petabyte scale SMR drive deployment
summary: Adapts Magic Pocket to sequential-only SMR by keeping metadata in the conventional area and staging live writes on SSD.

title: Optimizing web servers for high throughput and low latency
summary: Weighs latency against throughput for nginx edge knobs from NIC to event loop, verifying them with perf and bcc.

title: Pocket watch: Verifying exabytes of data
summary: Catches silent disk corruption and bad deletes that replication misses with a stack of Magic Pocket verifiers.

title: Inside the Magic Pocket
summary: Avoids quorum complexity in Magic Pocket by writing each block to every OSD in a volume and retrying elsewhere.
